name: DO3D
summary: Amazon filament brand focused on silk PLA (single, dual-colour, rainbow, metallic) plus basic and glow PLA bundles, in 1 kg spools and 250 g-spool bundles at about $17-23/kg. The Amazon seller is a Yiwu plastic-products company; extruder unknown.

product_lines.name: PLA Silk / Silk Dual Color / Silk Metallic
product_lines.notes: 1 kg $16.99-22.99; 8-colour 2 kg and 5-colour 1.25 kg bundles of 250 g spools, $18-20.50/kg.

product_lines.name: PLA Basic
product_lines.notes: 8-colour 2 kg bundle $39.99 (about $20/kg); 1.25 kg bundle $28.99 and 2 kg bundle $35.99 (the tracker's $/kg for these two, $115.96 and $143.96, is a calculation error).

additional_notes: Legal entity: Yiwusangxuansuliaozhipinyouxiangongsi (Business Name as printed; Yiwu Sangxuan Plastic Products Co., Ltd. is a rendering), Futian Subdistrict, Yiwu, Jinhua, Zhejiang; Amazon seller 'DO3D' (id A3CTI3X4IU6CMH), read 2026-11-06. The listing's Manufacturer field reads 'DO3D'. Store is Amazon only; no brand website found. The rendered name is a plastic-products company, but the address is a room in a multi-unit building, so whether it extrudes filament is not established.
